taxonomic_note: Accepted varieties exist; retain species-level learner identity.
look_here_first: Look closely at one apparent windmill: three separate asymmetric flowers open together within three involucral bracts. Then inspect a mature winged anthocarp and its glands to separate Allionia incarnata from A. choisyi.

best_field_traits: Trailing branched stems with paired unequal leaves.
Three simultaneously open asymmetric flowers make one flower-like display.
Mature fruiting perianth (anthocarp) has five ribs, wings and glands; inspect both surfaces.
morphology_keys.habit: Trailing or spreading herb; the selected photo shows stems against the ground, leaves and several flowering units.
morphology_keys.leaves: Opposite leaves in unequal pairs; close node photo still needed.
morphology_keys.flower: Each apparent flower-like unit comprises three separate asymmetric flowers with three involucral bracts.
morphology_keys.fruit: Winged/glandular five-ribbed anthocarp, typically 2.9–4.7 mm in the existing review, variable.
morphology_keys.lookalike_separators: Allionia choisyi requires mature fruit convexity, rib and gland-pattern comparison. Magenta color alone is inadequate. Varieties of A. incarnata overlap in dimensions; no variety assigned from source-only name or this habit photograph.

source_pool_review.taxonomy_review: Reviewed 2026-10-09 — POWO accepts Allionia incarnata L.; native to Texas at STATE level. Three project target counties not verified: range UNRESOLVED, learner source-pool approval preserved. POWO recognizes accepted varieties; do not silently assign var. incarnata from species-only observation. Sources: https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/8606-2 ; https://efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=220000445
source_pool_review.curation_status_before_install: Taxonomy reviewed — approved_pending_curation; range UNRESOLVED; not canonical
source_pool_review.diagnostic_notes: LOOK HERE FIRST: three simultaneously flowering asymmetric funnel-shaped flowers form one windmill-like display, with three distinct involucral bracts; paired unequal leaves. Verify 5-ribbed winged/glandular anthocarp; A. incarnata fruits typically 2.9–4.7 mm, variable. Distinguish A. choisyi using fruit convexity/rib and gland pattern, not magenta color. Varieties overlap in flower/fruit dimensions. PHOTO ROLES: three-flower unit plus bracts, winged mature anthocarp dorsal/concave surfaces and glands, paired leaf node.
source_pool_review.accepted_name_note: Accepted Allionia incarnata L.; Wedelia incarnata (L.) L. and Wedeliella incarnata (L.) Cockerell homotypic synonyms; three accepted infraspecifics per POWO, source variety unresolved.
